mdb_comparison.method: SELECT * filtered on SITENAME through read-only ADODB; keyed by SITENAME and RESNO. Every selected numeric row checked.
mdb_comparison.result: All fields match exactly numerically or as text/null except depth differences below. Every depth difference equals truncation of MDB depth to two decimals. Neither representation silently replaces the other.
